title: artemisia furcata subsp. tacomensis
intro: Artemisia furcata subsp. tacomensis, commonly known as Tacom sagebrush, is a subspecies of the Artemisia furcata plant, a type of shrub native to North America. Tacom sagebrush has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tacom sagebrush are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, such as thujone, camphor, and borneol, among others. Additionally, Tacom sagebrush has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and as an antiseptic to promote wound healing.
